checks.code:
from cache import Cache
import threading
c=Cache();entered=threading.Event();release=threading.Event()
def slow():entered.set();release.wait(2);return 1
t=threading.Thread(target=lambda:c.get('a',slow));t.start();assert entered.wait(1)
assert c.get('b',lambda:2)==2
release.set();t.join(2);assert not t.is_alive()
